body.statement: For a rationally well-bounded convex body in a rational affine subspace, weak optimization reduces in oracle-polynomial time to rational weak separation, with running time polynomial in the rational encoding and bounding data and logarithmic in the reciprocal requested accuracy.

attestation.note: The immutable core identifies this theorem as the weak rational convex-optimization result; the stable DOI is supplied in place of an unavailable verbatim transcription.
